reason: Two P2 autoreview follow-ups on host-owned gate wiring: the lint:changed npm script expands $files unquoted (a contributor-controlled filename like [f]oo.ts globs to another path, silently bypassing the blocking gate AC9 promises), and the stale-owner integration test never supplies a mismatched owner so raise's agentSessionId/provider/externalSessionId predicates are unverified. Both are two-file, in-scope edits to build wiring and a test; a full Codex delegate round for a shell quoting fix and a test loop is disproportionate to the change.
